'''2007 World Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed World Championship, 5–7 October 2007, in Chicago, Illinois. The constructed pool was Decipher-printed cards plus the [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|pre-reorg Virtual Sets]] legal in 2007 (not [[Legacy Open]] / Virtual Block). [[Jonny Chu]] defeated [[Justin Desai]] in the final.<ref name="hof">https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/</ref> Published lists are the Day 1–3 and Team PDFs on the Players Committee decklist desk.<ref name="tdl">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2007-decklists/</ref>


== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Site:''' Chicago, Illinois
* '''Dates:''' 5–7 October 2007
* '''Winner:''' [[Jonny Chu]]
